strongExistingCoefficientFamilies.support: Exact Midnight DE invested-point skill, learning and milestone terms; extra-output rates absent.

Primary Blizzard operation API supplies allocation-specific skill/difficulty/current-quality/bracketing thresholds. CraftSim supplies two/three/five-quality threshold models. Use exact recipe/input rank/era and conserve family units; no global skill-to-quantity coefficient.
Existing exact source gem-color replacement fractions conserve a shared source-family reservoir; skill and replacement are separate dimensions.
Full Courtly Supplier expected vector supplies primary1.289 and non-shard0.289unitmeans. This is stronger than an anonymous global-yield percentage but only a partly scoped full-reference endpoint.

Penguin720 logged rare outputs independently support pooledshards1.2875; skill93 label known but exactspec unknown. Authored140expectationvector pooled1.2961 hasnodenominator. Neither isolates skill effects.

boundedImplementationRules: Map specialization perks to recipe/item/operation scope before applying quantities. Recipe unlocks change eligibility, crafting speed/deftness change time, and ingenuity changes concentration cost; none inherently multiplies material output.
Apply Resourcefulness to expected input consumption or cost, never to per-completed-operation output quantity.

Existing guide applicability audit excludes Multicraft from Midnight milling/prospecting/crushing and all crafting stats from disenchanting. Ordinary crafting recipes need their own applicability flags.

Herbalism/Mining/Skinning gathering outcomes require a gathering target baseline; an ore-to-bar Smelt mean cannot stand in for an ore deposit gather. Fishing and Cooking have no specialization nodes in this pinned catalog; their controls need skill/stat/recipe context rather than fabricated tree nodes.
Unknown-context cohorts can supply synthetic benchmark priors only with explicit assumptions and reduced confidence; keep original observation identities, builds and sample counts immutable.
For stat ratings, prefer captured rating-plus-percentage API pairs or exact game conversions; do not silently treat one rating as one percentage point.
